description: Merge Split: a merge section combining up to four inputs into one polyphonic output, and beneath it a split section breaking one polyphonic input back out across four outputs

inputs.text: One of the four signals merged into the merge output; the lamp beside it glows red when its channels did not fit within the 16 that output can carry
The polyphonic signal broken out across the four split outputs

outputs.text: The four merge inputs combined into one polyphonic cable of at most 16 channels
Carries part of the split input. When that input has as many channels as the merge section took in, it matches the merge input of the same number and a lamp glows yellow; otherwise it is monophonic

menu: Channels, in a split output's own port menu — Resplit/1 leaves that output following the merge section, and 1 to 16 fixes its channel count
Restore resplit mode — puts all four split outputs back to following the merge section
